### Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the problem or pedagogical limitation is.

### Proposed Solution / Interactive Widget Concept
Describe the proposed interactive simulation, algorithm widget, or desktop functionality.

- **Track / Domain:** [e.g. Mathematical Foundations, Econometrics, Deep Learning]
- **Interactive Controls:** [e.g. 2D/3D Canvas with draggable vectors, parameter sliders]
- **Mathematical Formula:** [e.g. KaTeX LaTeX formulation]
- **Python Kernel Exercise:** [e.g. Vectorized challenge for learner to code]

### Visual Mockups or References
Reference any similar visualizations (e.g. 3Blue1Brown, Distill.pub, Brilliant.org, Mathigon).

### Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

### Additional Context
Add any other context, performance considerations, or accessibility notes.
